parameters.content:
## AI Content Engine
One long-form source in, five channel drafts out.

1. Ingest: blog URL (Firecrawl), audio URL (Whisper) or pasted transcript
2. Brief: extract core message, facts and hooks (no invention)
3. Draft: one call per channel with channel spec + brand voice
4. Gate: length, format, banned words, and every number checked against the source
5. Review: rows land on the Content Engine Approval Board as needs_review

meta.note: Credentials are not included. Add your own Anthropic, OpenAI and Firecrawl credentials (or n8n AI credits) after import, and create the approval board data table (see README).
